description: Create a RightSide project. Returns the project id, slug and generated HTTPS URL. Legacy PostgreSQL and hosted app authentication remain disabled unless database: true or auth: true is explicit. Safe to retry with the same idempotencyKey.

auth.description: Opt in to hosted app-user authentication at the gateway. Default false.

database.description: Legacy opt-in: provision a PostgreSQL database and role. Default false.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying so the project is created at most once. Generated when omitted.

name.description: Human project name; the routable slug is generated server-side.

name: create_project
